target.title: fix(telegram): silently skip empty-text sends
target.body:
Supersedes #59725 (auto-closed by the 10-open-PR cap; not reopenable because the close `stateReason` is `COMPLETED` and the branch was force-pushed since). ## Scope note: re-derived on top of current main Most of the original branch scope has since landed on `main` through other work, so this PR was reset onto `main` and re-implemented to cover only the residual gaps: - #56620 added `filterEmptyTelegramTextChunks` (`extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.replies.ts`), which already drops whitespace-only chunks before any send. - The `sendTelegramText` rewrite around `sendPlainFallback` / `buildTelegramPlainFallbackPlan` (`extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts`) already recovers formatted-send failures when a non-empty plain fallback exists. - #93279 introduced the default-vs-rich delivery split, which this PR preserves: the rich lane stays opt-in behind `richMessages === true` and both lanes get the same skip semantics. Two gaps remain on current `main`, and they are exactly the reported user path: 1. `EMPTY_TEXT_ERR_RE` only matches Telegram's legacy `message text is empty` wording. The live Bot API now also returns `text must be non-empty` (raw round-trip below), so the empty-text 400 escapes the recovery branch. 2. When non-whitespace source renders to empty visible text and the plain fallback is also empty (for example `` with `plainText: ""`), `main` throws (`empty rich text and empty plain fallback` / `empty formatted text and empty plain fallback`) or rethrows the 400 from the catch block, surfacing a user-visible delivery failure for content the model never made visible. ## Behavior addressed Interrupted mid-reply turns can produce formatted Telegram HTML that has no visible text and no plain-text fallback, for example an empty supported tag such as ``. Telegram rejects that payload with HTTP 400 (`message text is empty` legacy wording, `text must be non-empty` newer wording). Previously this surfaced as a user-visible delivery failure; this PR silently treats that empty-text send as a no-op with correct accounting. Parse errors remain out of scope and still throw (bare `
` payloads fail as parse errors, per the live baseline below). ## Change - `EMPTY_TEXT_ERR_RE` now also matches `text must be non-empty` and the rich-lane `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` rejection. - `sendTelegramText` returns `Promise`: when the rendered payload is empty and the plain fallback is also empty, it resolves `undefined` (silent no-op) instead of throwing, both pre-flight and when Telegram rejects the payload as empty. Sends with a usable plain fallback still recover exactly as on `main`; parse errors and unrelated failures still throw. - `sendChunkedTelegramReplyText` treats an `undefined` chunk result as a no-op: no `markReplyApplied`, no `markDelivered`, so skipped chunks do not advance reply state, delivered count, transcript mirroring, `message_sent.success`, or pinning, and do not consume the reply target. - Voice fallback text paths mirror only text that actually reached Telegram: an all-skipped caption fallback no longer registers `reply.text` as delivered transcript content. ## Verification Run after this patch (rebased branch head), from a worktree of current `main` + this commit: ``` node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.test.ts \ extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.skip-accounting.test.ts \ extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts -> 3 files, 81 tests passed node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/telegram -> 132/133 files passed, 2461/2462 tests passed. The single failure (bot.test.ts "does not retry plugin-owned callback text skipped by inbound policy") fails identically on a clean upstream/main checkout (827f2c4422) and is unrelated to this change. node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json -> clean node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json -> clean node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs -> clean oxfmt --check -> clean ``` ## Live Telegram round-trip Raw Telegram Bot API baseline (no OpenClaw code; still-valid proof of current Telegram wordings, motivating the regex widening): ``` payload="
" expected=parse-error -> error_code=400 description="Bad Request: can't parse entities: Unsupported start tag \"br\" at byte offset 0" payload=" " expected=accepted-by-telegram -> OK message_id=10657 payload="" expected=empty-text -> error_code=400 description="Bad Request: text must be non-empty" ``` A `tsx` driver importing the source-tree `sendTelegramText` was run against the live Bot API for the earlier revision of this branch (head `0a0035aa2818`, before the rebase onto current `main`); it observed `resolved=undefined` for `` with `plainText: ""`, thrown parse errors for bare `
` variants, and a real `message_id` for well-formed payloads. The rebased implementation pins the same `sendTelegramText` contract with the unit tests in `delivery.send.test.ts`; the live driver was not re-run against the rebased head. ## Real behavior proof Behavior addressed: Empty visible-text Telegram HTML sends with an empty plain fallback no longer surface as delivery failures; they are treated as no-op sends with no phantom delivery accounting, while parse errors and fallback-capable sends behave as on main. Real environment tested: Live Telegram Bot API (raw `sendMessage` baseline confirming the current `text must be non-empty` wording for ``; grammY driver run against the earlier revision of this branch), plus local Vitest runs of the rebased code against mocked Bot API surfaces. Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.skip-accounting.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` and `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/telegram` on the rebased head. Evidence after fix: 81/81 tests pass across the three delivery test files, including new regressions: `` + `text must be non-empty` resolves `undefined` (one API call, no throw); legacy `message text is empty` wording ditto; render-empty + empty-fallback skips before any API call on both default and rich lanes; empty-text 400 with a non-empty fallback still recovers via plain send; parse errors and unrelated errors still throw; all-skipped replies report `message_sent` `success=false` with no `messageId`, no transcript mirror, no pin, and `delivered: false`. Observed result after fix: Empty-text sends skip silently without advancing reply delivery state; payloads with real content or a usable plain fallback deliver unchanged; bare `
` HTML still throws the Telegram parse error and remains out of scope. What was not tested: The live grammY driver was not re-run against the rebased head (its output above is from the earlier branch revision); no full live interrupted-agent session was exercised. Focused regression tests cover send skipping, reply accounting, transcript mirroring, hooks, pin behavior, and voice fallback paths.
